scene_summary: The air in the Cave Entrance hangs heavy with the scent of damp earth and something vaguely metallic – a smell that clings to the back of your throats. Moonlight, fractured by a narrow opening high above, illuminates a chaotic scene of goblin skirmishes. Several goblins, clad in crude leather armor and wielding rusty knives, are frantically scrambling to defend a makeshift barricade constructed from loose rocks and fallen timber. A large, snarling goblin with a particularly vicious-looking scar is attempting to flank Thorin, while a dozen others are jostling for position around him. The cave floor is littered with broken stone and discarded weapons, and the flickering light reveals numerous tiny holes in the walls, suggesting a cramped and unstable space. A crudely drawn symbol of a serpent is etched into the rock near the barricade.
